126484 / 126484S: Cortech Endurance Cube All Purpose End Table
Product URL: https://www.anchortex.com/products/cortech-126484-endurance-cube-end-table
Manufacturer page: https://cortechusa.com/products/furniture/seating/endurance-cube/
Spec sheet: 126484 / 126484S
Recommended H1 and Subtitle
H1: Cortech Endurance Cube All Purpose End Table – 126484 / 126484S
Current H1: Cortech Endurance Durable Cube All Purpose End Table - 126484
Subtitle: One-Piece Molded End Table and Filler Piece for Dayrooms, with Optional Ballast Doors
Current subtitle: Cortech USA 126484 Endurance End Table Cube
Revised Product Description
Headings marked [H2] should be set as H2 on the page.
The Cortech Endurance Cube All Purpose End Table is a low, square molded table for dayrooms, lounges, and shared spaces in behavioral healthcare, correctional, and other secure facilities. It works as an end table, side surface, or filler piece between molded chairs.
The Cube is rotationally molded in one piece from high impact “no break” polyethylene, with no steel or wood components and a raised edge for easy clean-up. It can be bolted to the floor through concealed pilot holes, and the 126484S has underside ballast doors for adding weight with sandbags. The Cube is rated for outdoor use.
Material: One-piece rotationally molded high impact “no break” polyethylene; no steel or wood components
Top: Raised edge for easy clean-up
Dimensions: 24”W×24”D×15”H
Weight: 56 lbs
Ballast: The 126484S has underside ballast doors for adding weight with sandbags, secured with tamper-resistant screws
Outdoor Use: Rated for outdoor use and UV stabilized
Antimicrobial Testing: Tested to ISO 22196, showing a greater than 99% reduction in bacteria
Flammability Standards: Flame retardant; passes California Technical Bulletin 133 and UL 94 HB
Environmental Certification: GREENGUARD Gold
Easy Cleaning: Sound dampening, and easy to clean, sanitize, and maintain
Colors: Aqua, Black, Blue Gray, Brown, Burgundy, Canvas, Claylight, Gray, Green, Indigo, Midnight Blue, Moss, Overcast, Sand, Seagrass, Slate Blue, Stone Gray, or Tide (custom colors available on request)
Warranty: Lifetime warranty against manufacturing defects
Country of Manufacture: USA, made to ISO quality standards
Available Models and Options
126484 – Standard: Without access door, 56 lbs
126484S – With Access Door: Underside ballast doors for adding sandbags
Installation and Options
Floor Mounting: Bolt to the floor through concealed pilot holes with hardware of your choice
Ballast: Add sandbags through the 126484S ballast doors; Cortech says not to use loose sand
[H2] Applications
The Cube suits dayrooms and lounges that need a durable end table or filler piece between molded chairs.
Typical applications include:
Dayrooms and lounges in behavioral healthcare facilities and psychiatric hospitals
Dayrooms and common areas in correctional facilities and jails
Waiting rooms and residential treatment centers
Explore Anchortex's Behavioral Healthcare Anti-Ligature Furniture and Prison and Detention Furniture collections for more institutional furniture.
[H2] About Cortech Endurance Series
The Cortech Endurance Series is a line of heavy-duty molded furniture for behavioral healthcare facilities, correctional institutions, and other intense use environments. Endurance products are made for durability, easy cleaning, and safety-conscious design.
The Endurance Series includes:
Beds and Bunks: Endurance beds, wall-mounted bunks, and EZ Bunk stackable temporary sleep surfaces
Seating: Benches, cubes, and the Endurance ‘In Sync’ Modular Series chairs
Tables and Desks: Molded and laminate-top tables, freestanding desks, and wall-mounted desks, including ADA models
Storage: Lockers, nightstands, open chests, and shelving
[H2] About Cortech
Cortech manufactures durable molded furniture for demanding environments, including behavioral healthcare facilities, psychiatric hospitals, correctional institutions, law enforcement facilities, and homeless and emergency shelters. Explore the full line of Cortech Behavioral Health and Prison Furniture at Anchortex.
Meta Title and Description
Meta title (64 characters): Cortech Endurance Cube End Table - 126484 / 126484S at Anchortex
Meta description (152 characters): Shop the Cortech Endurance Cube. A one-piece molded end table and filler piece for dayrooms and lounges, with optional ballast doors and outdoor rating.
Notes and Questions
Series section: this is the same "About Cortech Endurance Series" section as on the EZ Bunk page.
H1: I took out "Durable," as on the Norix pages, and added the 126484S.
Weight: both variants are set to 27 lbs. The Cortech spec sheet says 56 lbs, so I used 56 lbs. This is a big difference, so you may want to double-check it.
Mounting: your current page says it bolts to the wall or floor. The Cortech spec sheet says floor only, so I used that.
Model numbers: your current page lists color codes "96484G" and "96484SB" for Gray and Slate Blue. These look like old model numbers, so I left the color codes out.
Warranty: your current page says 10-year warranty. The Cortech spec sheet says lifetime warranty against manufacturing defects, so I used that.
Colors: your current page lists 7 colors. The Cortech spec sheet lists 18, so I used the Cortech list.
I left out "Stain resistant" and "can be wiped, mopped, or even hosed down," since the Cortech spec sheet does not say these.
GREENGUARD Gold: this comes from the Cortech web page. The spec sheet does not mention it.
Outdoor use: the FAQ on the Cortech product page says the Cube is rated for outdoor use and UV stabilized, so I added it to the description.
Product images: the page has two images. The last image is the older Cortech color chart. Cortech now lists 18 colors. Would you like it replaced?
